title: Collateral Department Schedule — Parcel Release Terms for Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
When one parcel of several comes out from under a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage, five product terms apply:

- **Release premium** — the release price of one parcel of several, as a percentage of its share of principal, that share being the principal multiplied by the parcel's appraised value and divided by the total mortgaged value.
- **Partial release fee** — the fee per parcel released on sale or farmstead split while other parcels remain mortgaged, in USD.
- **Survey threshold** — a parcel carved out of a larger tract smaller than this many acres must be released on a recorded survey.
- **Largest principal after a release** — the largest principal after a release as a percentage of the value still mortgaged.
- **Release processing time** — the business days from approval of a release, or from payoff, to delivery of the recorded release of mortgage.

## Terms by product

| Product | Release premium (% of parcel's share of principal) | Partial release fee (USD) | Survey required below (acres) | Largest principal after a release (% of value still mortgaged) | Release delivered within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 110 | 350 | 40 | 75 | 30 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 110 | 350 | 40 | 75 | 30 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 110 | 350 | 40 | 75 | 30 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 115 | 350 | 40 | 70 | 30 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 115 | 500 | 40 | 70 | 30 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 120 | 500 | 40 | 65 | 30 |

## Working a parcel's share (hypothetical figures)

A loan with a principal balance of USD 480000 has parcels appraised at USD 1200000 in total, of which the parcel in question is appraised at USD 300000. Its share of principal is USD 480000 multiplied by 300000 and divided by 1200000, which is USD 120000.00. At a 110 percent premium the premium amount is USD 132000.00; at 115 percent it is USD 138000.00; at 120 percent it is USD 144000.00.

## Survey threshold boundary

A carved-out tract of 39.9 acres is smaller than 40 acres and is released only on a recorded survey; a tract of exactly 40 acres is not smaller than the threshold.
